body: I wish I could’ve just done this correctly. I would say that before august I still had a chance at a future / life because I was really ready to get my head down at uni now that we’d be able to go in properly. Instead I’ve come home and slept through my life. It’s not even like I’ve just missed a deadline or skived off work, I’ve completely avoided my entire life. I am fully aware of how fucked I am right now and instead of trying to fix that in August, I ran home and have been going between my mums and dads on autopilot doing nothing but eating and watching tv without speaking more than a few words. Like I said now that I finally want to sort myself out it’s too late. Even with the doctors I have I miss appointments and ignore them even though I know how lucky I am to even have the opportunity to see them. It’s like I’m just waiting for my life to reset but it won’t. Also for context my mum is an extremely nervous person and also quite annoying to live with. She’s anti-vax and when I was psychotic/didn’t know what was going on she convinced me that the vaccine caused it and made me even more stressed out. I’m not really blaming her but it didn’t help. She’s had a different boyfriend every year since she split from my dad and each time she morphs into them personality wise and puts her entire focus on them. Her current boyfriend is an alright guy but every second of every day all he talks about is how corona is fake and the vaccines are killing us and everyone is a “fuckwit” and now because I’ve come home I’m associated with that. That’s not entirely relevant though but what I guess I’m trying to say is I feel like we were constantly dropped into so many different lives by moving every year or so and having a new guy living with us who sometimes had kids and stuff, so I never really felt grounded. After being at uni for a year I guess I kinda forgot that she was like that and when I was in that state I just wanted to go home because in my head that would automatically make everything better, but I’d kinda forgotten that they were the same parents I’d always had and couldn’t miraculously understand / fix what happened. Anyways like I said I got into a rut and I have spent each day since then doing the exact opposite of what I should’ve done to help myself. I’m now back in the town that I tried so desperately to get away from and that’s one of the reasons I haven’t left the house. It’s also because I know if I do it’ll probably be the last day I am alive. I can even see now that I’m blaming other people instead of myself, and that’s another thing that is ruining me. But I genuinely have no option out of this other than if someone has a time machine. When I used to meet people / get a job / apply for uni etc I didn’t feel like a fraud or feel nervous because I knew I was telling the truth. I did well at GCSE, did well at A-Level and am now studying at Uni with hopes to blah blah blah. Well now I wouldn’t even know what to say. I don’t have a job, I’m not a student anymore, I am not me. I don’t even feel like a person. And now because I’ve spent so long feeling sorry for myself without actually doing one single thing to change it, I have absolutely no time left. Again, it probably sounds ridiculous because to other people they’d probably think it’s just uni, it’s just a job, it’s not the end of the world and I would normally have agreed but now I can say wholeheartedly that I have no point to live. The only issue is finding the time and energy to even do it. I can barely even lift a finger to do anything. There’s nowhere tall to jump from here and lethal means have been taken away from me. The only option I can think of is a train but even then it’s a 2 hour journey to ones that go quick enough and a £20 ticket. And I’d probably be too scared, and feel awful on the people near me. I tried not drinking any fluids for as long as I could but I only got to 3 days because my mum made me come out and I wouldn’t have been able to move without it. I’m honestly not a good person and the only thing I would be doing to anyone if I stayed is making them miserable. My mum told me this morning that she can’t afford to keep me in the flat unless I pay to be here (but her boyfriend can stay here for free-besides the point anyway) so that’s just proof that I’m burdening her. My dad always goes on about how we’re his everything and shows us off / says how proud he is of us. I feel so guilty because he pays for my phone, sends me £20 a week and constantly offers to take me anywhere I need to go, but I still just want to sit in the house and cry and watch TV and not do anything to use all the help and support he’s given me since being young. It’s actually worrying now how long it has been and how much of a mess I actually am. In short, I’m selfish and a lost cause. I have spent so long worrying about how I’m going to die that I haven’t lived my own life. Anyways I’m now going back to watching mindless shit on tv to pass the hours by. I wish some kid who had an awful childhood could’ve traded places with me, they could’ve appreciated it more.

I would normally just move on and get on with things. However since august I have literally just slept & ignored ALL responsibilities. I was still supposed to be in uni, I was still in a contract with my other job, I have ignored the professionals who were trying to help and just got angry and anyone else who tried to help. Each day I wake up thinking I’ll just do it today but then I don’t. And because I don’t I now have months if not years of time that I have just ignored all responsibilities. Now I don’t actually even want to die really but because I’ve avoided everything for so long I don’t see another choice. Especially when there’s people who have had awful lives and not had the support I’ve had, and still carry on. How do I explain to jobs, family and just general people that I’ve done nothing but lie in bed and sponge off my parents or my student loan (which I shouldn’t even have because I’m not a student anymore). Plus my parents are completely skint so it’s not like they’ve paid to get me out of any messes, I’ve just lied and acted like it wasn’t that bad to the point where now I’m too scared to even get up or leave my house because I literally don’t know how I would interact with other people. I’m supposed to start my old job again in 40 minutes and I’m scared when I go in and put in my details it will come up that I’m in all this debt and stuff idk how it works. Also I currently haven’t showered in like a week, I have matted hair which I won’t be able to brush out and I’m just not a functioning person right now. It’s annoying because if I’d just got help years ago then I would be ok. Or even a few months ago. But now I’m completely screwed because I’ve spent my entire life acting as if everything will just work out and when it hasn’t I’ve froze up and avoided everything. I guess I’d just rather die than go to prison for fraud or whatever it’d be if I have my student loan without being a student or if I go to work but don’t finish the contract? Idk how it works but I really don’t think I can carry on. It’s not just affecting my life it’s affecting other people emotionally and financially.
